coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Eleven attacks run, none landed. Read the scope before recording: what is accepted is a scoped naming act, not a closure. DR-133's leftover-design stays open, NT-3 and NT-5 still have no obligation, D-056 gates 2 and 3 still do not hold, and the row stays OPEN and not SATISFIED — the artifact says all of this itself. Custody is clean: b74e3009 at 0444 unmoved, dispatch and prompt agreeing, v5 frozen, HEAD never left 1ac85c7, file 08 and COORD at their pins with a clean tree, and all five file pins reproducing. My v5 finding lands in full. The new liveStanding.thisSuccessorCondition4Effect states that recording this successor names no new identifier, that DR-G20 and DR-G21 are already in the 18 and already NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED, that the condition-4 effect is therefore zero, that condition 4 stays MET on the naming half and below QUALIFIED, and that the inherited condition4EffectIfLaterRecorded is a D-086-era recital rather than this successor's effect. Because that sentence is essentially the one I drafted, I checked whether it is true rather than whether it matches my request: I compared every identifier-bearing field across all 22 gates against v3 and found zero differences, with executes and doesNotClaim on two gates the only changes anywhere in the array; I confirmed both gates sit in requiredNow and carry NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED; and I read file 08's condition-4 row directly, where the standing is MET and the cell says every assurance stage is below QUALIFIED. All six claims hold. The diff against v5 is the smallest in this family: no gate changed, no key or list element was removed, and the only additions are that field and one disposition entry whose pointer resolves. I also re-derived the load-bearing content rather than trusting two prior reviews — the join artifact's riding map puts NT-1, NT-2 and NT-6 at DR-G21 and NT-4 and NT-7 at DR-G20, all five appear in the right gate's executes in the DR-102 CC-1..CC-11 form, and NT-3 and NT-5 appear in neither. Two items are recorded as considered and declined, both already declined at v5. This artifact is ready for the D-000 recording that D-144 Decision 3 created as owed work.
